title: Canon Forge
valueStatement: Locked character, set, and shot contracts so image and video models render inside canon instead of reinventing the face and the room.
architectureHighlight: Express generation proxy with identity-lock prompts and canon stills in front of Gemini, xAI, Bedrock, Venice, or local SD.
description: A character-reference architect for generative production: lock a person, a set, and a shot grammar so image models stay inside canon. Identity is an approved headshot plus a prompt contract, not a paragraph the model is asked to remember. Video is Veo 8-second clips and SceneForge keyframe sequences — not a full editorial pipeline.
pitch: Locked character, set, and shot contracts so image and video models render inside canon instead of reinventing the face and the room.
challenge: Image models drift. A headshot, a wardrobe turn, a library interior, and a medium shot of the same figure will not stay one canon unless identity, set, and camera are locked assets — not a prompt you hope the model remembers.
development: Built a TypeScript/React/Vite suite (CharacterForge, SetForge, CompositorForge, SceneForge) with an Express proxy. Generations go through /api/generate (Gemini, xAI Grok Imagine, Venice, Bedrock Titan/SD, local SD). Default client provider is xAI. Canon stills attach as reference or init images where the provider allows it. SceneForge builds keyframe sequences and a flipbook; /api/generate-video calls Veo for 8-second clips. Profiles persist in localStorage. GitHub Actions lint and build; node:test covers identityLock and provider helpers.
outcome: Public source at github.com/rubyrayjuntos/canon-forge. Needs provider keys on the Express server. This static portfolio cannot host it. Render.yaml and a GHCR Docker workflow exist; the Dockerfile in tree is a dev stage. Not a multi-tenant SaaS.

gallery.title: Production control plane
gallery.description: Face mesh, set wireframe, locked composite, and frame strip on one console — identity through the cut

journey.title: Stop asking the model to remember the person
journey.description: Treated identity as an approved asset plus a written identity-lock block. The canon headshot is attached when the provider accepts a reference image.

journey.title: Lock the room the same way
journey.description: Sets declare spatial invariants, landmarks, forbidden changes, and a lighting-rig lock. Wide/medium stills become the set’s reference the same way the headshot does for a face.

journey.title: Compose, then generate
journey.description: CompositorForge only fires after character, set, action, lens, and landmark lock are specified. The model is a renderer inside a shot list.

journey.title: Four forges, one production grammar
journey.description: Character, Set, Compositor, and Scene tabs share CharacterProfile / SetProfile / CompositeConfig / KeyframeScene so a later frame cannot quietly become a different actor in a different room — unless the model ignores the contract, in which case the take is rejected, not auto-canonized.

journey.title: Provider is a swap, not the product
journey.description: Moved keys server-side. Gemini, xAI, Venice, Bedrock, and local SD share one generate path. Veo is the video path. Pollinations leftover is unused.

specs.title: Canon headshot as identity kernel
specs.description: Approved reference stills live on the character profile. Later prompts include an identity-lock block; Gemini (and some other providers) also receive the still as a reference or init image. This is not a face-embedding or InstantID model.

specs.title: Set invariants and lighting lock
specs.description: Indoor/outdoor sets declare spatial invariants, fixed landmarks, forbidden changes, and a lighting-rig lock in the prompt. Wide/medium canon URLs lock the environment the same way.

specs.title: Shot grammar before pixels
specs.description: Compositor specs encode shot type, camera angle, lens preset, subject distance, emotion, and landmark lock — production language, not a vibes prompt.

specs.title: Multi-provider renderer
specs.description: Express /api/generate routes Gemini, xAI Grok Imagine, Venice, Amazon Bedrock (Titan / SD), and local Stable Diffusion. Client default in source is xAI. The model does not own canon.

specs.title: Veo clips and SceneForge keyframes
specs.description: /api/generate-video calls Veo (default veo-3.0-fast-generate-001) for an 8-second 16:9 clip. SceneForge generates a timed still sequence and plays it as a flipbook. Not an NLE, not lip-sync, not a finished editorial pipeline.

specs.title: Vite app + Express, not this site
specs.description: React 19 + Vite 6 + TypeScript + Express. Keys stay on the server (the old Vite define leak is gone). This static portfolio cannot host it.
